items.title: 20.2 Medical imaging mein ultrasound ka diagnostic (pehchan ke liye) istemal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.2, diagnostic use of ultrasound (PDF 158-159); d = vt/2 is ours (Roman Urdu only).

blocks.text: Ultrasound medical imaging ka aam tareeqa hai jis se doctors body ke andar ke hisse real time (usi waqt, live) dekh sakte hain. Ultrasound machine ka labelled diagram Fig. 20.2 mein hai. Machine transducer naam ke device (aale) se high frequency (bohat zyada frequency) ki sound waves, aam taur par 1 MHz se 15 MHz, body mein bhejti hai. Yeh waves body mein chalti hain aur mukhtalif tissues ki boundaries (sarhadon) se takra kar reflect hoti (palatti) hain. In reflected echoes (wapas aane wali awazon) ko jama aur analyze (jaanch) kar ke image (tasveer) banai jati hai. Bara faida yeh hai ke ultrasound ionizing radiation istemal nahi karta, is liye yeh safe (mehfooz), non-invasive aur baar baar kiya ja sakne wala tareeqa hai.

Ultrasound imaging kuch physics ke principles (usoolon) par chalti hai. Pehle piezoelectric transducer ultrasound ke pulses (chhote chhote jhatke) bhejta hai. Yeh har tissue mein alag speed se chalte hain. Jab wave do aise tissues ki boundary par pohanchti hai jin ki acoustic impedance (awaz ke guzarne mein rukawat; yeh tissue ki density aur us mein awaz ki speed se tay hoti hai) alag ho, to wave ka kuch hissa reflect ho kar wapas aata hai. Phir transducer receive mode (sunne wali halat) mein chala jata hai aur direct piezoelectric effect se in reflected waves ko detect karta hai. Echoes electrical signals (bijli ke signals) mein badal kar machine mein process hote hain. Aakhir mein computer har echo ke wapas aane ka time delay (der) aur us ki intensity (taqat) se image banata hai. Jahan reflection zyada strong ho woh hissa image mein zyada bright (roshan) dikhta hai; is tarah organs aur tissues ki andar ki banawat nazar aati hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Ultrasound probe ke crystals chawal ke daane se bhi chhote hote hain, phir bhi awaz ki waves bhej bhi sakte hain aur pakar bhi sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: trolley par ultrasound machine, labels Screen, Controls aur Cable connection. Daen: skin surface par dabaya hua transducer probe; skin ke neeche mure hue wavefronts (lehron ki lakeerein) tissue mein ek organ ki taraf phailte hain; labels Transducer probe, Skin surface, Skin, aur baen aur daen taraf Tissue.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.2: ultrasound machine (kitab ki Figure 20.2 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Probe skin par rakh kar ultrasound pulses andar bhejta hai (safaid lehrein). Tissues ki boundaries se echo wapas probe tak aati hai. Pulse boundary tak ja kar wapas aata hai, is liye echo ke aane ka time t ho to boundary ki depth (gehrai) d = vt/2 hai, jahan soft tissue mein awaz ki speed v taqreeban 1540 m s⁻¹ hai.
